summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. (1) positionGroup RangeError: the only production caller of sessionReport is the end-session transaction in src/storage/hand-store.ts, which passes only records that parseHandRecord accepted (invalid records become null and are filtered out). parseHandRecord requires button to be a whole number 1..10 and in the dealt-in seat set ('button' check after checkSeats), and checkSeats ties userSeat to the single user seat, so the two RangeError branches in positionGroup cannot be reached from stored data. If they were, the throw is caught in write() and the transaction aborts, so it fails closed with no partial report written. The report screen reads stored reports through parseSessionReport and never calls positionGroup. (2) Stored leakCounts: parseLeakCounts uses order.indexOf over the LEAK_CATEGORIES id array, so an unknown id, a non-string id or a key like '__proto__' gives -1 and is rejected; counts are bounded whole numbers with errors <= decisions and major <= errors. The 16 new preflop ids pass because they are in LEAK_CATEGORIES. (3) Prototype pollution: categoryCounts and BY_ID use Map, and handCategoryDecisions uses a Map keyed by index. No objects are indexed by untrusted strings, and the category text comes from bundled JSON validated at load and rendered as React text. No new dependencies, randomness or secrets.
